_note: Machine-checkable form of the Deliverable Quality Bar in SKILL.md. Worksheet coverage, per-row fields and per-red counts are code; heuristics are checked against the skill's own examples, since a copied example is by construction not product-specific.

structural.bar: correctly evaluates all six sensitivities for every product
structural.desc: the worksheet covers all six sensitivities

structural.bar: uses "Enabled to..." framing for every opportunity area
structural.desc: every worksheet row has an Enabled-to opportunity

structural.bar: names a specific psychological mechanism for every 🔴 and 🟡 row
names at least 2 specifically vulnerable populations for every sensitivity row
structural.desc: every sensitivity row names at least 2 populations

structural.bar: proposes at least 3 alternatives per 🔴 sensitivity (minimal / structural / radical reframe)
structural.desc: every 🔴 sensitivity reaches a third (radical) alternative

structural.bar: names the specific KPI or OKR that must change to fix each 🔴 finding
structural.desc: a business tension is stated for every 🔴 sensitivity

structural.bar: produces a Compound Harm / Exploitation Stack Analysis identifying 2-3 multi-feature stacks
structural.desc: the Exploitation Stack table names 2-3 stacks

structural.bar: with at least one redesign that breaks the stack rather than fixing one feature
structural.desc: names a redesign that breaks a stack

structural.bar: ends with 3-5 memorable heuristics specific to this product

examples: If the metric goes up when the user feels worse, it's not a humane metric.
If we can't show this design to a 14-year-old's parent without flinching, we shouldn't ship it to 14-year-olds.
Defaults are decisions made for the user — make them visible.
If a streak punishes a missed day, the streak is the punishment.
If the tip prompt appears before the food arrives, it's a toll, not a tip.
structural.bar: ends with 3-5 memorable heuristics specific to this product, designed to be quoted in future design reviews
structural.desc: no heuristic is lifted from the skill's own examples

structural.bar: runs the Algorithm Audit when any scoring, ranking, or recommendation system is present
structural.desc: an Algorithm Audit section exists when the product ranks or recommends

structural.bar: explicitly surfaces the Engagement-Value Paradox when the success metric conflicts with user wellbeing
includes a humane design statement that the team could adopt as a design principle
structural.desc: a Humane Design Statement section exists
